task.title: Remove fallen trees blocking Pine Avenue
task.description: Heavy wind and rain have caused multiple large trees to collapse across the east end of Pine Avenue, blocking both lanes of traffic. The debris includes broken branches, fallen streetlights, and scattered trash.

taskLogs.summary: Team cleared northbound lane; still 2 large trunks remaining.
City waste unit arrived; coordination in progress.

resourcesNeeded.label: Protective gloves, helmets, and reflective vests
A small truck for debris transport

skillsRequired: Basic understanding of traffic control or hazard marking
Physical strength and ability to lift heavy objects
